deviation: The 1x cap matches the standard, but the draft leaves out the playbook's uncapped carve-outs for IP infringement indemnity and breach of confidentiality, so Arcadia's recovery for those is capped. It also adds uncapped liability for gross negligence and willful misconduct, which the playbook doesn't allow. And 11.2 adds a consequential-loss and lost-profits exclusion that isn't in the standard, which would limit recovery even for confidentiality breaches.
suggested_text: 11.1 Subject to Section 11.2, each Party's total aggregate liability arising under this Agreement shall not exceed one (1) times the annual Fees paid or payable. 11.2 The limitation in Section 11.1 does not apply to liability for (a) fraud; (b) indemnification for third-party intellectual property infringement claims; (c) breach of confidentiality obligations; or (d) any liability that cannot be limited under applicable law. [Delete the draft's Section 11.2 exclusion of indirect and consequential damages and lost profits. If the supplier insists on a mutual exclusion, it must not apply to the liabilities in (a) to (d) above. Delete gross negligence and willful misconduct from the uncapped carve-outs.]
